# KPN Roofing Shed

> Roofing Shed Construction Company in India

KPN Roofing Shed designs and builds steel roofing sheds for industrial, agricultural, home, and recreational projects across India, using Apollo-brand steel and an in-house, Coimbatore-manufactured flooring line backed by a 10-year guarantee.

## Services
- [Industrial Solutions](https://kpnroofingsheds.com/services/industrial-sheds) (Factory Shed, Garment Factory Shed, Warehouse & Godown)
- [Agricultural Solutions](https://kpnroofingsheds.com/services/agriculture-animal-husbandry-sheds) (Goat Farm Shed, Cow / Dairy Farm Shed, Poultry Farm Shed)
- [Home Roofing](https://kpnroofingsheds.com/services/home-roofing-sheds) (Terrace Roofing Shed, Car Parking Shed)
- [Sports Turf](https://kpnroofingsheds.com/services/sports-turf-sheds) (Badminton Court Shed, Cricket Turf Shed)

## Community
- [Corporate Social Responsibility](https://kpnroofingsheds.com/corporate-social-responsibility) (CSR initiatives supporting students and sports)
- [Gallery](https://kpnroofingsheds.com/gallery) (Project showcases)

## Key Facts
- 13+ Years Experience
- 1000+ Projects Completed
- Pricing up to Rs. 599/sq.ft
- Fast Timeline: 6 days for 1440 sq.ft, 1 month for 2400 sq.ft
- 10-Year Warranty, 3-year replacement on flooring
